verdict.rationale: Recruitee documents a public REST API that uses bearer-token authentication. Its endpoints let you list and create candidates, create offers (jobs or talent pools), show departments, add profile fields, and use a separate Careers Site API. The docs are served as llms.txt and as markdown, which suits AI-native consumption. missing for 10: no machine-readable OpenAPI/Swagger spec (all probed paths returned 404), no independent or hands-on corroboration of driving the API end to end.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: a client (any application that would like to use the API) needs to authenticate first with a header `Authorization: Bearer <token>`
